reviews.text:
Thank you for looking after Paloma. She came home calm.

However, her little brother, who is recovering from an illness, stayed with us and refused to be around Paloma. Was it the smell or the peace and quiet? He hissed and spat for two days.

Thank you to the Sainte Cyle cattery in Marseille for taking such good care of my cats Ulk and Tchip and for sending regular updates. Thanks to you, I was able to have a peaceful holiday.

See you next year! 👍
Our cat Saja had a great stay and even made a friend named Lifou. Thanks to the team!
Nuance and Ekko are doing very well; they haven't left our side since Wednesday.
First time for my cat, it went very well, I received reassuring updates. The team was welcoming and attentive, thank you Chloé.
Very attentive to your cat's needs

Payett (according to what she told me! 😸) had a great stay and was very well cared for.
When we leave her at the cattery, we regularly receive updates and photos, which is very reassuring. Thank you.

We left our cat with them three times between May and August of this year and were very satisfied with the service, the welcome, and the overall experience. The staff regularly provides updates on our cat, which is much appreciated. We highly recommend this establishment.
Rolly doesn't want to go home anymore... he's so happy at the cattery after several stays. We highly recommend it.

Thank you for your feedback!
Give Rousky lots of cuddles from us!
Excellent welcome, the cattery is very well laid out, I highly recommend it. I will definitely bring my cat back.

Thank you so much for your feedback!
Give Orion lots of hugs from us!

As with every stay at the Ste Cyle cattery, the staff is always very competent, smiling, very kind, and above all, professional.
My little furball receives excellent care; she's looked after very well.
I have absolutely no complaints about this establishment. I would order again without hesitation. ❤️

The staff took excellent care of my cat, and I was able to go on holiday with complete peace of mind.

Thank you.

I highly recommend this cat hotel. The staff is very welcoming, caring, and above all, attentive to the well-being and comfort of our furry friends! The place is clean and well-equipped to accommodate our pets. I entrust my little cat to them with complete confidence.
This cattery is fantastic; our cat Harry was very well cared for. The staff are incredibly kind and welcoming. A very good experience. I highly recommend this establishment.

Relief and complete confidence in the team at Chatterie de la Valentine. They take excellent care of our pets, the service is top-notch, and the regular updates (photos) are especially reassuring. Go there without hesitation.
A reputable establishment. Excellent care for our cat. Highly recommended!
After a short weekend, I found Jazzy in great shape, still happy to have been pampered at the cattery.
Excellent cat hotel; we felt reassured leaving our cat at this establishment. We appreciated the kindness shown to our little feline friend.
Our cat was very well received and pampered. The team provides frequent updates on your cat to reassure you that everything is going well. Thank you to them!
Excellent welcome from the team, attentive to our cats.
Adapted well to the cat, gives regular updates, first stay for my cat in this type of establishment so a little complicated for him, but very satisfied.

Hello
Everything is fine with bianchitto
Thank you
See you soon

A clean, quiet place, perfectly suited to the well-being of cats. The staff is professional, attentive, and reassuring.

We highly recommend it! 👍
Very happy with the services for my cat Réglisse, very friendly staff, lovely establishment 👍👍😻 …
Very good welcome and exchanges, limited space but clean, bright, and well equipped, few cats per space in February, which was appreciated.

Chiva's second stay at this cattery! I found her in great shape and, most importantly, noticed upon her return home that being around other cats had changed her attitude towards my other cat. Usually, she hisses at him as soon as she sees him, but this time, no reaction at all. They sat about two meters apart, without any tension! We're currently booking her next stay this summer. A huge thank you to Sophie and Chloé for their excellent care!

The place is very clean and quiet. All the staff are incredibly attentive and knowledgeable about cats. They are mindful of our pets' personalities and adapt to them. We receive updates during our stay, which is very reassuring to know that our cat is doing well when we're not there.

Gribouille had a wonderful stay. No stress on the return trip.
Thank you.

We entrusted our kitten to the cattery for the first time. It was his first experience with other cats in a group setting, and everything went very well despite his shyness. The team was wonderful and took excellent care of him throughout the week. We received regular updates, which we greatly appreciated!
Thank you to the team; we will definitely entrust our kitten to you again!
Perfect, as always!

This is the third time we've left Chanel at this cattery (La Valentine). They are exceptional people with big hearts who take great care of our animals, adapt to their individual needs, and provide regular updates to reassure us (photos, messages, etc.). I highly recommend them if you want to go on vacation or travel with complete peace of mind. Thank you so much for your kindness.
I highly recommend this cattery. My little cat Réglisse was very well cared for. The place is very clean and Chloé is very gentle with the animals.
Thank you so much for your feedback, give your little cat some scratches from us!

Thank you, Chloé, for restoring Togo's confidence during his stay; everything went wonderfully this time. I got my cat back in perfect health. The bad experience in February, when your absence was unfortunately felt, is now a distant memory. See you soon for new adventures.
I highly recommend them! I received regular updates about my cat without having to ask. The staff were very friendly.
Excellent cat hotel! Réglis found his way home without any problems. Thank you again for him, see you soon!

Excellent cat daycare.
My two cats were delighted with their stay.
An exceptional welcome and impeccable service throughout our vacation! A huge thank you for the dedication and love shown to Yugi! We will definitely be back! 🥰 …
Always at the top
Diva had a good stay. She received a warm welcome at the hotel.

01/09/25

Owen had a fantastic stay, cuddled by Chloé! Finally, I was able to enjoy my vacation with complete peace of mind! Thank you so much!

I left my cat there for a week: it was his first time and everything went very well.
The enclosures are clean and air-conditioned. I receive regular updates.

I recommend this cattery.
Thank you to the team.

The staff were very welcoming and took excellent care of my cat Elliott. We would return without hesitation and with complete confidence for all our holidays. Special mention also for the cleanliness of the place... and the air conditioning in summer.... a big thank you.
We were very satisfied with the service. We had a peaceful holiday. We would definitely repeat the experience.

I left my cat Vanille with them for 10 days while I was on vacation.

The team is very kind and competent; after just two days, she quickly adapted to the other cats.

Every two days, I received updates and photos of my cat.

I recommend the Sainte Cyle Cattery in Marseille.
Vanille came back for three days in August, a little lonely, but she was perfectly fine when she returned home.

I recommend the Sainte Cyle Cattery in La Valentine; they are clean and attentive to our cats.
As usual, nothing to complain about… top-notch! Thank you for Pepper who had a great holiday.

Perfect!
As before, my cats are being looked after with love and care.
Thank you to the team!
Thank you for your feedback!

Excellent cattery. The staff are lovely and incredibly attentive. The facilities are very clean and perfectly suited for cats. Updates are provided very regularly. Individual attention is given to ensure the best possible care tailored to each cat's needs and personality. I entrust my two cats to them without hesitation.

For the past 7 years, Figaro has spent 15 days in Sainte-Cyle. We leave with complete confidence, thanks to a dedicated team who send us photos and updates every two days. I highly recommend this establishment! 🤗👍 …

Very satisfied with the Sainte Cyle cattery. My little Lola had a great weekend with her friends. The trip home was easy. The staff is attentive and gives good advice. I recommend this cattery. Mrs. Cefalia
It took Mimousse two days to readjust, but everything is fine now.

We just picked up our Réglisse today. He spent 17 days at this cattery. We want to thank Chloé so much; she was absolutely lovely. She truly loves animals, and Réglisse was so happy. Now it's like a hotel for our sweet baby! 😻🐈‍⬛ We also want to thank Sophie, who was very reassuring. You are the best, a superb team, and Réglisse absolutely adores you all.

🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼 Thank you again so much.

I highly recommend this cat hotel. I was very anxious about leaving my little cat for the first time, and everything was perfect. I received photos and updates throughout the stay and could call if needed. Thank you!
Excellent cattery, Chloé and the team were wonderful despite the challenges of managing my cat during her stay. They were kind, helpful, and showed great affection towards the cats.

I left my cat at this establishment for six days. It was his first time. Despite a few days of adjustment, everything went very well. I received updates about my cat approximately every two days. Upon returning home, my cat quickly settled back into his routine.

Thank you to Chloé for her kindness 🙏
Laurie & Cookie
Good establishment
A very welcoming place for our cats, with a friendly and attentive team. My kitten had a great stay.

Every cat is different.
Our Myrval didn't adapt well...because she was used to being with us.
She ate very little and didn't enjoy her stay at all.
It's also worth noting that the cattery closed at 3 pm until the following morning, so the cats were left alone.
That wouldn't have made any difference for Myrval.
I even think she must have moved around a bit when no one was there.
Others might feel lonely.
P.S. Chloe is very sweet.

Excellent experience – I felt completely safe entrusting my cat to them during my vacation. Frequent updates, including photos, were reassuring. If needed, I will definitely return to the St. Cyle cattery with complete confidence.

Trustworthy establishment!

I left my cat Django there several times this summer and I was delighted with …

I left my cat in a group setting for a week.

I'm completely satisfied with his week. …

I left my little César there again, and as usual, he was pampered and spoiled rotten.
My mind was at ease.
Thank you to the whole team.

Hello everyone, first of all, I want to thank the team at the Sainte Cyle cattery so much for looking after my 7-month-old kitten, Oréo, for 15 days. It was a first for both us and Oréo, but everything went perfectly. Without us even …

I left my 7-month-old kitten at this cattery for the first time (for 8 days). Everything went well, even though my cat is usually outdoors a lot. The staff is very friendly and provides updates as soon as they can (with photos). I have complete confidence in the Sainte Cyle cattery and wouldn't hesitate to use their services again!
